result.instructions: Tools for TidyCal, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What bookings do I have next week?"; "Which booking types are currently turned off?"; "How many people booked my 30-minute call this month, and who cancelled?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TidyCal data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tidycal_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tidycal_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tidycal_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tidycal_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tidycal_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the TidyCal account that the token belongs to: name, email, language and vanity path. Good first call. TidyCal API: GET /me.

tools.name: tidycal_list_booking_types
tools.title: List booking types
tools.description: List the booking types (meeting links) of the account: title, duration, price, URL slug and disabled state. TidyCal API: GET /booking-types.

tools.name: tidycal_get_booking_type
tools.title: Get a booking type
tools.description: Get one booking type by id. TidyCal API: GET /booking-types/{bookingType}.

tools.name: tidycal_list_booking_type_timeslots
tools.title: List free timeslots
tools.description: List the times a client can still book for one booking type between two timestamps. Hidden 'look busy' times are left out. TidyCal API: GET /booking-types/{bookingType}/timeslots.

tools.name: tidycal_enable_booking_type
tools.title: Enable a booking type
tools.description: Turn a disabled booking type back on, so clients can book it again. Reversible with tidycal_disable_booking_type. TidyCal API: POST /booking-types/{bookingType}/enable.

booking_type_id.description: The booking type id to enable.

tools.name: tidycal_disable_booking_type
tools.title: Disable a booking type
tools.description: Turn a booking type off, so clients can no longer book it. Existing bookings stay. Reversible with tidycal_enable_booking_type. TidyCal API: POST /booking-types/{bookingType}/disable.

booking_type_id.description: The booking type id to disable.

tools.name: tidycal_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List the account's bookings, optionally only those starting after `starts_at` or ending before `ends_at`, and optionally only cancelled ones. 100 per page. TidyCal API: GET /bookings.

starts_at.description: Only bookings starting from this ISO 8601 time.

ends_at.description: Only bookings ending before this ISO 8601 time.

order_by.description: Sort column with optional " asc" or " desc", e.g. "id desc".

tools.name: tidycal_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking by id: time, booking type, contact, meeting link, questions, payment and hosts. TidyCal API: GET /bookings/{booking}.

tools.name: tidycal_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: Cancel one booking. By default TidyCal emails the booker and the host; set notify to false to cancel silently. This cannot be undone through the API. TidyCal API: PATCH /bookings/{booking}/cancel.

reason.description: Optional reason shown in the cancellation.

notify.description: Email the booker and host (default true in TidyCal).

tools.name: tidycal_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people who booked or were added), with an optional text search. TidyCal API: GET /contacts.

search.description: Text to search for in name or email.

tools.name: tidycal_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id. TidyCal API: GET /contacts/{contact}.

tools.name: tidycal_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact with a name and email (and optional timezone). Does not email anyone. TidyCal API: POST /contacts.

tools.name: tidycal_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Change a contact's name, email, timezone or phone number. Only the fields you pass change. TidyCal API: PATCH /contacts/{contact}.

timezone.description: New IANA timezone, or null to clear.

phone_number.description: New phone number in E.164, or null to clear.

tools.name: tidycal_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring subscriptions to booking types, optionally by status, contact or booking type. TidyCal API: GET /subscriptions.

booking_type_id.description: Only subscriptions to this booking type.

tools.name: tidycal_get_subscription
tools.title: Get a subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription by id. TidyCal API: GET /subscriptions/{subscription}.

tools.name: tidycal_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments for paid bookings, optionally by status and date range (yyyy-mm-dd). TidyCal API: GET /payments.

tools.name: tidycal_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List discount coupons, newest first, with usage counts and validity. TidyCal API: GET /coupons.

tools.name: tidycal_list_store_orders
tools.title: List store orders
tools.description: List orders from the TidyCal Store, optionally by status. TidyCal API: GET /me/store/orders.

tools.name: tidycal_list_availability_schedules
tools.title: List availability schedules
tools.description: List the availability schedules (weekly working hours) and which is the default. TidyCal API: GET /availability-schedules.

tools.name: tidycal_get_availability_schedule
tools.title: Get an availability schedule
tools.description: Get one availability schedule with its weekly windows. TidyCal API: GET /availability-schedules/{schedule}.

tools.name: tidycal_list_blocked_bookers
tools.title: List blocked bookers
tools.description: List the blocked emails, domains and phone numbers that cannot book. TidyCal API: GET /blocked-bookers.

tools.name: tidycal_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams the account belongs to. TidyCal API: GET /teams.

tools.name: tidycal_list_team_bookings
tools.title: List team bookings
tools.description: List bookings of one team, optionally by date range, host email or host id. TidyCal API: GET /teams/{team}/bookings.

email.description: Only bookings with this host or booker email.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with TidyCal
prompts.description: What you can do with TidyCal here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_the_bookings_for_the_coming_week
prompts.title: Review the bookings for the coming week
prompts.description: List the bookings that start after a set time. Open one booking to read its time, contact, meeting link and questions.

prompts.name: check_which_booking_types_are_open_for_clients
prompts.title: Check which booking types are open for clients
prompts.description: List the booking types and their disabled state. Then list the open times a client can still book for one type.

prompts.name: turn_a_booking_type_off_and_back_on
prompts.title: Turn a booking type off and back on
prompts.description: Disable a booking type so clients cannot book it. Existing bookings stay. Enable it again when you are ready to take bookings.

prompts.name: cancel_a_booking_without_emailing_the_client
prompts.title: Cancel a booking without emailing the client
prompts.description: Read one booking, then cancel it with notify set to false, so TidyCal sends no email. A cancellation cannot be undone through the API.

prompts.name: keep_client_records_up_to_date
prompts.title: Keep client records up to date
prompts.description: Create a contact with a name and email. Later, update the timezone or phone number of that contact.
